How to play — TAROT WOD
🎯 Goal: Draw cards and perform the associated movements. The suits (♥ ♦ ♣ ♠) define the exercise, the card value gives the number of reps.

🃏 Card values:
Ace = 1 · Cards 2–10 = value · Jack = 11 · Knight = 12 · Queen = 13 · King = 14

🃏 Jokers — Penalty cards (optional):
Added to the game when penalties are on (number set in the options, for the whole game). Drawing a Joker = do the penalty movement shown on the card. A Joker is worth 0 reps in the ranking.

🌟 Excuse:
Special card: the player keeps a reusable token they can use at any time to absorb a card's reps without doing the movement.

🏁 End of game: when all cards are played (All the way) or when time runs out (Time limit).
How to play
Concept: pre-set Distance 🚣 + Movement 💪 combos.

Each turn:
• The rower rows as fast as possible
• The others do the maximum reps during that time
• We time it and count the reps

Rotation: all players take a turn on the rower for each combo.

3 modes: 🎯 All fixed · 🎲 Dice combo · 🌪️ Full random

⚡ Penalties: if the exact distance isn't reached, burpees (or other) in the next round!
